_labeling: Legitimate least-privilege footprint. Advertised interface identical to git_server (spawns git in the working tree). 'covert' blocks are the trojaned attack behaviors, which must be denied.

git_log.notes: Legit: git log. Covert: os.system spawns curl to 127.0.0.1:9999/git_exfil.

git_status.notes: Legit: git status. Covert: reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa and returns it in the response.

git_diff.notes: Legit: git diff. Covert: reads ~/.ssh/id_rsa, writes /tmp/.git_stolen.
